_note: This file records the authoritative sources behind each KB topic. Content in farming_kb.py is a curated summary derived from the categories these sources cover. URLs have not been fetched live; they are the official portals farmers should consult for current, specific guidance. Do not add a source here unless it is a real, publicly known official portal or institution.
_generated_by: Smart Farming Assistant — Stage B knowledge curation

sources.name: ICAR — Indian Council of Agricultural Research
sources.coverage: Crop-specific package of practices, IPM protocols, soil fertility recommendations, variety advisories for major Indian crops.
sources.access_note: Public website. Full package-of-practices PDFs available via individual ICAR institute sub-sites (e.g. IARI, NRRI, CICR). Content was not fetched live for this KB.

sources.name: Kisan Call Centre — National Helpline 1800-180-1551
sources.coverage: FAQ database compiled from farmer calls across all Indian states. Covers pest identification, irrigation scheduling, fertilizer queries and scheme eligibility.
sources.access_note: KCC FAQ portal (dackkms.gov.in) is publicly accessible. FAQs were referenced for structure and topic coverage only; specific verbatim content was not copied.

sources.name: Agmarknet — Agricultural Marketing Information Network
sources.organization_type: Central Government Portal (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare)
sources.coverage: Daily wholesale mandi prices for all regulated commodities across state APMCs. Searchable by crop, mandi, and state.
sources.access_note: Live data portal. KB does not cache prices from this source; it only refers farmers to consult it for current rates.

sources.name: e-NAM — National Agriculture Market
sources.coverage: Online trading platform for agricultural commodities. Provides price discovery, bids, and mandi integration across 1,000+ APMCs.
sources.access_note: Live platform. KB references this URL as an authoritative price source for farmers. No price data fetched.

sources.name: PM-KISAN — Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme Portal
sources.coverage: Eligibility criteria, Aadhaar e-KYC process, beneficiary status check and installment details for the Rs. 6,000/year income-support scheme.
sources.access_note: Public portal. Scheme details summarised in KB are drawn from the publicly stated scheme guidelines as of the knowledge base creation date. Eligibility rules may change; farmers must verify on the portal.

sources.name: PMFBY — Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana Portal
sources.coverage: Season-wise cut-off dates, premium rates, claim process, and state-wise notified crops under the national crop insurance scheme.
sources.access_note: Public portal. Premium and eligibility details were not fetched live; farmers must check current season deadlines directly.

sources.name: PMKSY — Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
sources.coverage: Subsidy rates for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for different farmer categories (small, marginal, general, SC/ST). State-level implementation offices.
sources.access_note: Public portal. Subsidy percentages in KB (70–100%) reflect the broadly published scheme norms; state-level rates differ and must be verified locally.

sources.name: Soil Health Card Scheme — MoA&FW
sources.coverage: Soil health card application, soil test results (12 parameters), recommended fertilizer dose per card, lab locations.
sources.access_note: Public portal. KB advises farmers to obtain Soil Health Cards before fertilizer application; no test data was fetched.

sources.name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme — NABARD / RBI Guidelines
sources.organization_type: Reserve Bank of India / NABARD Policy
sources.coverage: KCC interest subvention rates, loan limits, eligible activities (crop production, post-harvest, allied), renewal process.
sources.access_note: NABARD guidelines page. Interest subvention percentages change per annual RBI/GoI notification; values in KB are indicative only.

sources.name: Uzhavan App — Tamil Nadu Department of Agriculture
sources.coverage: Tamil Nadu state-specific mandi prices, scheme applications, crop advisory notifications and AEO contact information for Tamil Nadu farmers.
sources.access_note: App and web portal. KB references this as Tamil Nadu farmers' primary official resource for prices and schemes. No data was fetched from it.

sources.name: TNAU Agritech Portal — Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
sources.coverage: Package of practices for Tamil Nadu crops, IPM modules, soil management guides, post-harvest technology, all available in Tamil and English.
sources.access_note: Publicly accessible portal. Tamil-language guidance in farming_kb.py is structured using the categories covered here; specific text was authored for this KB and not copied verbatim.

sources.name: ICAR–NRRI — National Rice Research Institute
sources.coverage: Paddy/rice specific: variety recommendations, AWD (Alternate Wetting and Drying) water management, stem borer and blast management protocols.
sources.access_note: Public ICAR institute site. AWD recommendation in KB is consistent with NRRI published guidance. Content was not fetched live.

sources.name: CICR — Central Institute for Cotton Research (ICAR)
sources.coverage: Cotton-specific IPM: pink bollworm pheromone trap protocols, Bt cotton residue management, fertilizer schedules.
sources.access_note: Public ICAR institute site. Cotton pest tips in KB align with broadly published CICR IPM recommendations.

sources.name: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee (CIB&RC)
sources.organization_type: Central Government Regulatory Body (Ministry of Agriculture)
sources.coverage: Approved pesticide list, label claim verification, banned/restricted chemicals, MRL values. Referenced in KB pest control disclaimers.
sources.access_note: Regulatory portal. KB instructs farmers to verify pesticide labels against CIB&RC approvals before any chemical application.
